change_request.title: Fix X-Opaque-Id header propagation (along with other response headers) for streaming Reactor Netty 4 transport
change_request.author: reta

task.task: Fix X-Opaque-Id and other response-header propagation in the streaming Reactor Netty 4 transport, including responses sent before stream subscription.
subtasks: Enrich streaming response headers with ThreadContext response headers and the request's X-Opaque-Id, including the sendResponse path; avoid updating status or headers after headers have been sent.

Buffer response content sent before the streaming emitter is ready and drain it after subscription, preserving listeners and final-content handling. Enforce a 64-message limit and report overflow with IllegalStateException.
Add StreamingRequest.setOptions overloads for RequestOptions and RequestOptions.Builder, rejecting null arguments.
Expose all response headers and first-header lookup on StreamingResponse, including error responses; return null when a requested header is absent.
Add streaming bulk integration tests verifying X-Opaque-Id echoing and successful delivery of all records, plus HTTP 400 and ResponseException handling for duplicate X-Opaque-Id headers.
Add a changelog entry describing the streaming response-header propagation fix.

change_request.title: Tighten convert_tz offsets to MySQL band [-13:59, +14:00]
change_request.author: vinaykpud

task.task: Enforce MySQL’s inclusive [-13:59, +14:00] offset range for CONVERT_TZ, returning NULL for out-of-band source or destination offsets while preserving valid conversions.
subtasks: Update ConvertTzAdapter to validate offsets using sign-specific total-minute limits and minutes <= 59. Reject invalid offsets in canonicalizeTz with IllegalArgumentException so adapt() folds literal calls to a typed NULL, and apply the same validation to identity-short-circuit eligibility.
Update Rust parse_offset_seconds to enforce the same bounds, ensuring invalid column-valued timezone offsets yield NULL rows at runtime.
Add Java unit tests accepting -13:59 and +14:00, rejecting -14:00, +14:01, -17:00, +15:00, and +05:60, and verifying out-of-band literals fold to NULL with the original return type.
Add Rust parser and full UDF-dispatch tests covering accepted boundaries and NULL results for out-of-band source and destination offsets.
Extend sandbox CONVERT_TZ integration tests to verify NULL for -14:00 and +14:01, unchanged timestamps for identical -13:59 offsets, and correct conversion to +14:00.

change_request.title: [analytics-engine] Add per-backend delegation predicate block-list setting
change_request.author: sandeshkr419

task.task: Add a dynamic per-backend predicate delegation block-list to the analytics engine so operators can disable delegation at runtime without making predicates unexecutable.
subtasks: Register analytics.delegation.<backend>.blocked_predicates as a Dynamic, NodeScope affix list setting, empty by default. Parse trimmed, case-insensitive ScalarFunction names and report unknown names clearly.

Implement DelegationBlockList with per-backend EnumSet membership checks, initial settings seeding, and live affix updates and clearing. Validate nonempty entries against runtime FILTER-delegation acceptors and their delegated predicate serializers, rejecting invalid settings with descriptive errors.

Bundle the block-list and shard-bucket oversampling factor in a hot-reloadable PlannerSettings wrapper. Have DefaultPlanExecutor create and inject it into PlannerContext, preserving existing planner accessors and default behavior.
Apply the block-list in OpenSearchFilterRule.resolveViableBackends: remove blocked backends only when at least one non-blocked viable backend remains; otherwise retain the viable set.

Add tests for token parsing, empty defaults, settings seeding, dynamic updates and clearing, invalid namespaces and predicates, and filter marking behavior for blocked, all-blocked, and unknown-backend entries. Update oversampling tests to use PlannerSettings.
Mark the existing locale-sensitive str_to_date timestamp separator mismatch as a known issue in TwoShardScalarIT.

change_request.title: Add skeleton for tiering services and common utilities
change_request.author: GeekGlider

task.task: Add server-core skeletons for hot-to-warm and warm-to-hot tiering services and shared tiered-storage utilities, deferring operational logic and metrics integration.
subtasks: Create abstract TieringService implementing ClusterStateListener with shared dependency initialization, tiering-index tracking, disk/file-cache settings, and abstract hooks for validation, start/cancellation settings, concurrency settings, start-time keys, and tiering states.

Add injectable HotToWarmTieringService and WarmToHotTieringService subclasses. Leave clusterChanged and concrete service hooks throwing UnsupportedOperationException("Not yet implemented"); defer listener registration, settings update consumers, tiering workflows, and TierActionMetrics wiring.
Add TieringUtils with tiering metadata constants and a HOT/WARM Tier enum supporting trimmed, case-insensitive parsing, rejection of null or unsupported values, and lowercase serialization.

Define dynamic, node-scoped cluster.tiering settings for hot-to-warm concurrency (default 200, range 0–1000), warm-to-hot concurrency (default 10, range 0–1000), file-cache active usage (default 90%, range 0–100), and JVM usage (default 95%, range 0–100).
Add TieringRejectionException with structured RejectionReason values and preservation of the original runtime exception's message and cause.
Add a BlockTransferManager skeleton holding the remote stream reader, index settings, thread-pool supplier, and concurrent in-progress download tracking; defer download orchestration.
Add package documentation for org.opensearch.storage.common, org.opensearch.storage.common.tiering, and org.opensearch.storage.tiering.

change_request.title: Analytics Engine: Make reduce stage's initial partition count configurable
change_request.author: mch2

task.task: Make the Analytics Engine coordinator-reduce initial partition count configurable through a dynamic cluster setting.
subtasks: Register the node-scoped, dynamic integer setting datafusion.reduce.target_partitions with default 4 and valid range 1–32; apply its initial value and forward runtime updates.
Wire NativeBridge.setReduceTargetPartitions through the df_set_reduce_target_partitions native export to a thread-safe Rust setter/getter that defaults to 4 and clamps values to 1–32.
Initialize new coordinator-reduce LocalSession instances from the configured value instead of the hard-coded partition count.
Update settings-registration tests and add Rust tests for setter/getter round trips, boundary values, and clamping, restoring the default afterward.
Add integration tests for acknowledged dynamic updates, rejection of values outside 1–32, and correct GROUP BY group counts with partition counts of 1, 4, and 16.

task.task: Make BulkItemRequest immutable and construct a new BulkShardRequest containing primary responses for replication instead of attaching responses in place.
subtasks: Convert BulkItemRequest to a record with id, request, and primaryResponse components; remove response mutation and abort methods while preserving serialization and the two-argument constructor.

Collect primary responses separately in BulkPrimaryExecutionContext, use them to build shard responses and replica requests, and validate completed-state invariants without requiring requestToExecute for no-op or failure paths.

Add BulkShardRequest.setPrimaryResponses to validate the response-array length and create new items while preserving null entries, shard ID, refresh policy, timeout, active-shard requirements, routing cluster version, and parent task; centralize replication-property copying in ReplicationRequest.
Update replica execution to use the record accessor and assert that primary responses are present.

Adapt bulk execution tests to inspect returned replica requests rather than mutated inputs, remove tests dependent on the deleted abort API, and add coverage for response attachment and request-property copying.

change_request.title: Validation of the `_source` object in request and deprecation of ambiguous usage
change_request.author: urmichm

task.task: Validate contradictory `_source` filters and deprecate ambiguous empty forms while preserving existing filtering behavior.
subtasks: Validate includes/excludes in the FetchSourceContext constructor, rejecting identical entries in both with IllegalArgumentException and the message `The same entry [<entry>] cannot be both included and excluded in _source.`
Emit deprecation warnings for `_source: {}`, `_source: []`, and explicitly empty includes/excludes arrays without rejecting them. Recommend `_source: true` for fetching the entire source.
Require string elements in source-filter arrays, remove duplicates while preserving order, and improve parsing errors for invalid tokens and missing field names.
Serialize disabled source fetching as `false`, unfiltered fetching as `true`, and filtered fetching as an object containing only nonempty includes/excludes arrays.

Add unit and gRPC conversion tests for conflicting filters, supported parsing forms, empty-form warnings, deduplication, and invalid parser input. Add version-gated REST YAML tests verifying warnings, preserved filtering results, and HTTP 400 illegal_argument_exception responses for conflicts.

change_request.title: Improve exception messaging when encountering legacy version IDs
change_request.author: msfroh

task.task: Improve exceptions for unsupported legacy Elasticsearch version IDs so opening or upgrading an Elasticsearch-created index produces a human-readable compatibility error instead of an OpenSearch-mask error.
subtasks: Add a documented Version.UnsupportedVersionException extending RuntimeException, exposing the readable version through getVersionString(). Have Version.fromId reject nonzero IDs lacking the OpenSearch mask with this exception and format legacy IDs such as 7090199 as 'ES 7.9.1'.

Catch UnsupportedVersionException in IndexMetadata.indexCreated and wrap it in an IllegalArgumentException stating that the index UUID and creation version are unsupported by the current OpenSearch version, preserving the original cause.
Add regression tests for legacy version parsing and index metadata creation using version ID 7090199, verifying the exception type, readable version, and preserved cause.
Replace Version.stringHasLength with Strings.hasLength in Version and SemverRange, and remove the redundant helper.
Add a changelog entry describing the improved error for Elasticsearch-created indices.

change_request.title: Stub support for streaming-transport request handlers in MockTransportService
change_request.author: mch2

task.task: Support stubbing streaming-only request handlers in MockTransportService and fix analytics streaming batch reordering.
subtasks: Add a default pass-through Node.wrapStreamTransport hook before the streaming transport is shared by TransportService and StreamTransportService. Override it in MockNode to install StubbableTransport only when MockTransportService.TestPlugin is present.

Have MockTransportService reuse an existing streaming StubbableTransport or wrap a plain transport. Add handler lookup support and route addRequestHandlingBehavior to the regular registry first, then the streaming registry, preserving the existing error for unknown actions.

Process ShardFragmentStageExecution.onStreamResponse inline on the per-stream thread rather than offloading to the search executor, preventing the final batch from completing the stage before earlier batches are consumed.
Add a deterministic unit regression test using a reverse-order manual executor to verify that both streaming batches reach the sink.

Create the sandbox/qa/analytics-engine-coordinator internal-cluster-test module with the required analytics, Flight, DataFusion, Parquet, composite-engine, and PPL dependencies and runtime configuration.

Add a coordinator integration test that stubs the streaming-only FragmentExecutionAction with an empty schema-bearing Arrow batch, completes the stream, and verifies that the stub fires and the coordinator returns a valid reduced aggregate.

change_request.title: Relevance Functions Optional Param Support, Refactor and support new functions
change_request.author: nssuresh2007

task.task: Refactor Lucene relevance-query serialization into modular serializers, support optional parameters and new relevance functions, and fix space-separated timestamp parsing.
subtasks: Introduce AbstractQuerySerializer and AbstractRelevanceSerializer under the Lucene serializers package, and migrate the seven existing relevance serializers into dedicated classes registered by QuerySerializerRegistry.
Expose shared ConversionUtils helpers and add optional key-value parameter extraction from RexCall operands, skipping malformed or nonliteral entries and returning an empty map when no options exist.

Implement per-function optional parameter handling for match, phrase, prefix, multi-match, and query-string serializers, including typed conversions and pipe-separated simple-query-string flags; preserve defaults and ignore unknown parameter keys.

Add WILDCARD_QUERY, QUERY, and MATCHALL to ScalarFunction and Lucene backend capabilities. Register serializers mapping them to WildcardQueryBuilder, fieldless QueryStringQueryBuilder, and MatchAllQueryBuilder, with required-operand validation and supported options.
Update TimestampFunctionAdapter to retry space-separated datetime strings by replacing the space with T before falling back to TimestampString.

Add serializer round-trip tests covering existing and new functions, optional parameters, defaults, missing required operands, unknown options, and simple-query-string flags; extend utility extraction tests and add a timestamp regression test for space-separated milliseconds.
